summary: Two things this session. First, the operator blessed the Phase 5b design (an organization IS a wallet — its own identity, issuing membership attestations; organizations nest; zero new key architecture). Second, and the focus of the session, the operator connected Phase 5b to social recovery and asked for the existing recovery design to be read from the repo and fully worked in. MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md section 12 was expanded from a one-paragraph by-reference note into a full treatment that captures the operator's framing: your recovery cohort is not configured separately — it IS the network you have already woven, the Phase 5a handshake peers and the Phase 5b organizations you belong to. The 'slime' is the operator's mycelial name for the shares: the encryption key to the cloud-mirrored backup blob is Shamir-split, each share held by a trusted node (a peer or an organization), and gathering M of N shares back reconstructs the key and restores the whole verifiable life. Recovery is initiated with no pre-stashed key (M peers verify the operator's face, then encrypt their shares to the fresh keypair), and M peers co-sign a recovery-succession event. The load-bearing constraint is unchanged — the split is over the backup encryption key, never the signing keypair. The slime framing was logged to ideas.md.

why.text: Operator confirmed Phase 5b and said: read the existing recovery design in the repo and get it all worked in, because the organizations, the peers, and recovery all nest together. Grounded by re-reading the ideas.md 2026-05-21 recovery entries and the existing section 12 before editing — verify, don't trust memory.
